main.description: A self-asserted statement by the repo owner. Proves nothing alone; attestations countersign it. See docs/acp.md §Self-claims.

id.description:
The edge id: hex(sha256(min(a,b) + '
' + max(a,b) + '
' + expiresAt + '
' + nonce)), a = claimant, b = the payload's counterpart DID or a itself. Recomputed by verifiers (ACP spec, Self-claim; FORKS F48).

nonce.description: 16 random bytes, lowercase hex; shared by both halves of a paired claim.

claimant.description: The repo owner's DID. Checked against the repo the record was fetched from; never read as it.

kind.description: Claim kind: an NSID of exactly five segments, <tld>.<domain>.acp.<category>.<name> (ACP spec, Claim kinds). The authority owns the meaning; the category is ACP's closed list; unknown kinds must validate and be ignored, never rejected.

payload.description: Kind-defined content, e.g. { "address": "a@b.c" } for kind "email". Opaque to the protocol.

expiresAt.description: Required. No permanent claim exists; a far-future date is semantically permanent.

status.description: The claimant's own revocation lever (ACP spec, Status lists).

witnesses.description: Third parties who signed this record's pre-image (record minus `witnesses`, plus the $sig binding). Optional; no verdict requires one.

sig.description: Signature over the CIDv1 of the claim pre-image (ACP spec, Signing).
